comment: Independent potion.c witness for dip_potion_explosion() with a lit potion of oil: the debug Valkyrie wishes a potion of oil and one of fruit juice, lights the oil, and dips it into the juice. A lit oil always explodes, and useupall() frees it through shk.c obfree(), which stops its burn timer (timeout.c obj_stop_timers()) and deletes its light source (light.c del_light_source()).
